content.json:
This proof-of-concept workbook reads health events from SOCHealth and SentinelHealth through Advanced Hunting. Each health query uses a fuzzy union so the same workbook can run when either Defender XDR health or Microsoft Sentinel health data is available.

SOCHealth fields are normalized to the SentinelHealth names used by the workbook: ResourceId, ResourceName, ResourceType, ResourceKind, and AdditionalFields become SentinelResourceId, SentinelResourceName, SentinelResourceType, SentinelResourceKind, and ExtendedProperties.

This health-only version intentionally excludes Logic Apps AzureDiagnostics details, SecurityIncident inventory, SentinelAudit views, playbook execution diagnostics, and billing views.

For Microsoft Sentinel data, enable health monitoring in Sentinel settings. Learn more: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/enable-monitoring.

Use 'Show help?' to show or hide guidance below each visualization, and 'Show workbook introduction?' to hide this introduction.

content.query:
let __SentinelXdrUnifiedHealth = union isfuzzy=true
(
    SOCHealth
    | project-rename
        SentinelResourceId = ResourceId,
        SentinelResourceName = ResourceName,
        SentinelResourceType = ResourceType,
        SentinelResourceKind = ResourceKind,
        ExtendedProperties = AdditionalFields
),
SentinelHealth;
let Health = union isfuzzy=true
(
    __SentinelXdrUnifiedHealth
    | project TimeGenerated, OperationName, Status, Reason, Description,
        SentinelResourceId, SentinelResourceName, SentinelResourceType,
        SentinelResourceKind, RecordId, WorkspaceId, ExtendedProperties,
        TenantId, Type, SourceSystem
),
(
    datatable(
        TimeGenerated:datetime, OperationName:string, Status:string,
        Reason:string, Description:string, SentinelResourceId:string,
        SentinelResourceName:string, SentinelResourceType:string,
        SentinelResourceKind:string, RecordId:string, WorkspaceId:string,
        ExtendedProperties:dynamic, TenantId:string, Type:string,
        SourceSystem:string
    )[] | where false
);
Health
| where SentinelResourceType == "Automation rule"
| where Status == "Failure"
| summarize ['Unsuccessful executions']=count(Status) by ['Display name']=SentinelResourceName
| top 5 by ['Unsuccessful executions']
content.title: Top 5 failed Automation rules
